newsitem.title: USA: MEDIQ subsidiary extends tender to Sept.27.
newsitem.headline: MEDIQ subsidiary extends tender to Sept.27.

text.p: MEDIQ Inc said Monday that its subsidiary MEDIQ/PRN Life Support Services Inc has extended until September 27 a cash tender offer to buy all of PRN's 12 1/8 percent senior secured notes due 1999.

The tender is at a price of $1,078.74 per $1,000 principal. The outstanding principal balance of the notes is $100 million; about $90.6 million had been tendered through September 20, the company said.
MEDIQ operates movable critical care and life support equipment in the United States.
